_about: The Sunken Ruins of Atal'narath (src/population.py; the zone's own mobiles block was never loaded). Merfolk who made the ruins their home; sahuagin raiders and their priestess and Baron; reef sharks, water elementals, the drowned; the giant octopus and an abyssal angler; Nerathis, the Drowned King, on his throne, with whirlpools to swim out of and his drowned subjects rising.

13100.name: merfolk warden
13100.long_desc: A merfolk warden glides here, trident ready, watching the ruins.
13100.description: Scales of blue-green from the waist down, a warrior's calm above. The merfolk have made a home of the drowned city, and they guard it.

helpers.shout: The merfolk warden calls through the water: "To me, kin!"

13101.name: sahuagin raider
13101.long_desc: A sahuagin raider prowls here, trident low, rows of teeth bared.
13101.description: Shark-headed, shark-skinned and shark-hungry. Sahuagin hunt in packs and hate the surface folk.

helpers.shout: The sahuagin screeches, and the water fills with teeth!

13102.name: water elemental
13102.long_desc: A being of living water flows here, its form never still.
13102.description: Water given will. Its eyes are whirlpools; in the deep it is nearly unstoppable.

13103.name: reef shark
13103.long_desc: A reef shark circles lazily overhead.
13103.description: Grey, quick and patient. It has learned that the ruins bring food.

13104.name: drowned one corpse
13104.long_desc: A waterlogged corpse drifts here, animated by old magic.
13104.description: Once a citizen of Atal'narath. Fish have taken the fingers; the hunger remains.

13110.name: giant octopus
13110.long_desc: An enormous octopus fills the cave, tentacles curling from the dark.
13110.description: The size of a cottage and twice as clever. It has survived decades by being smarter than what it eats.

13111.name: sahuagin priestess
13111.long_desc: A sahuagin priestess chants to the deep, a coral staff raised.
13111.description: Barnacled jewellery, a shark's grin, and a voice that carries through water like a bell.

helpers.shout: The sahuagin screeches, and the water fills with teeth!

13112.name: drowned royal guard
13112.long_desc: A drowned royal guard stands its post before the vaults, halberd crossed.
13112.description: Its armour has rusted green; its oath has not.

13113.name: abyssal angler
13113.long_desc: A pale light bobs in the black, and beneath it, teeth.
13113.description: A fish as long as a boat, eyeless, with a lure of cold light and a jaw that opens wider than it should.

13120.name: sahuagin baron
13120.long_desc: The Sahuagin Baron lounges on a throne of bones, watching you with flat black eyes.
13120.description: Bigger than its kin by half, scarred by a hundred raids. Its trident is tipped with a sea-dragon's tooth.

helpers.shout: The Baron roars, and its raiders come for blood!

13130.name: drowned king nerathis
13130.long_desc: Nerathis, the Drowned King, sits his coral throne, crown green with age.
13130.description: The last king of Atal'narath would not leave his city when the sea came. He has not left it since. Water pours from his mouth when he speaks.

phases.message: Nerathis rises from his throne, and the whole palace groans with the weight of the sea!

abilities.name: Crushing Tide
abilities.telegraph: Nerathis raises his arms, and the water above you darkens!

abilities.name: Trident of the Deep
abilities.telegraph: Nerathis levels his trident at you!
